sub_type: pygmy blue whale - Australian / SE Indian Ocean (type-8) song
spectral_peak_Hz: ~20-26 Hz (unit 2 fundamental 20->26 Hz); Leroy 2018 used the ~70 Hz harmonic as the detection unit
duration_s: units ~20-48 s; phrase of 2-3 units (Samaran 2013: unit 1 20 Hz 20 s + 21 Hz 22 s; unit 2 20->26 Hz 23 s; unit 3 18-19 Hz 26-48 s)
rise_time_or_envelope: emergent, long tonal units; no impulsive onset
waveform_description: stereotyped tonal / FM units with strong harmonics; multi-unit phrase
repetition_pattern: phrase every ~200 s (Samaran 2013); P3 170-194 s, P2 84-96 s, P1 45-49 s inter-song interval (Jolliffe 2019); bouts minutes to hours
typical_received_level_at_basin_range: detection range at Cape Leeuwin H01 ~50 to ~200 km only (Gavrilov & McCauley 2013 abstract); local source, not basin range
occurrence_season_SE_Indian_Ocean_March: YES: Cape Leeuwin Dec-June (Stafford 2011); Perth Canyon Nov-June, peak March-June, northbound Feb-June (Erbe 2015; Gavrilov 2012 via Jolliffe 2023)
diel_pattern: Gavrilov & McCauley 2013 report a diurnal analysis; direction not retrieved
bearing_behaviour: near-field (<~200 km); back-azimuth drifts slowly as the whale swims (tracked by bearing, Gavrilov & McCauley 2013 via Jolliffe 2023)
distinguishing_features_vs_impact: tonal harmonic stack, tens of seconds per unit, strict repetition at ~45/90/200 s; no broadband impulsive onset; energy concentrated in 18-26 Hz lines
likely_present_8Mar2014: yes - H01W, Perth Canyon 3315/3376 (in season, near peak)
example_library_or_dataset: IMOS AODN passive acoustic archive (raw Perth Canyon/Portland); DOSITS audio gallery; Leroy 2021 Fig. with Perth Canyon March 2008 song
reference: Samaran et al. 2013 PLoS ONE 8:e71561 (p.4 call descriptions); Jolliffe et al. 2019 PLoS ONE 14:e0208619; Stafford et al. 2011 Mar Mamm Sci 27:828; Gavrilov & McCauley 2013 JASA 134:2505; Erbe et al. 2015 Prog Oceanogr 137:38
read_in_primary: Samaran: yes (full text); Jolliffe, Stafford, Gavrilov, Erbe: abstract/search extract only; DOSITS SL second-hand
